topic.name: The CDF of the Poisson Distribution

question.text:
Using the cumulative distribution function table of the Poisson random variable $X \sim \textrm{Po}(5.3)$ given below, compute $P(5 \leq X \leq 8).$

$ \quad x \quad $ $3$ $4$ $5$ $6$ $7$ $8$ $9$
$ P(X\leq x) $ $\,0.2254\,$ $\,0.3895\,$ $\,0.5635\,$ $\,0.7171\,$ $\,0.8335\,$ $\,0.9106\,$ $\,0.9559\,$
question.explanation:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

\[ F(x) = P(X \leq x). \]

So, we have

\begin{align*} F(8) &= P(X \leq 8) \\[3pt] &= P(X \in \{ 0,1,\ldots,8\}) \\[3pt] &= P(X \in \{ 0,1,2,3,4\}) + P(X \in \{ 5,6,7,8\}) \\[3pt] &= P(X \leq 4) + P(5 \leq X \leq 8) \\[3pt] &= F(4) + P(5 \leq X \leq 8). \end{align*}

Therefore,

\begin{align*} P(5 \leq X \leq 8) &= F(8) - F(4) \\[3pt] &= 0.9106 - 0.3895 \\[3pt] &= \bbox[4pt,border: 1px solid lightgray]{0.5211}. \end{align*}

question.text:
Using the cumulative distribution function table of the Poisson random variable $X \sim \textrm{Po}(3)$ given below, compute $P(5 \leq X \lt 9).$

$ \quad x \quad $ $4$ $5$ $6$ $7$ $8$ $9$ $10$
$ P(X\leq x) $ $\,0.8153\,$ $\,0.9161\,$ $\,0.9665\,$ $\,0.9881\,$ $\,0.9962\,$ $\,0.9989\,$ $\,0.9997\,$
question.explanation:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

\[ F(x) = P(X \leq x). \]

So, we have

\begin{align*} F(8) &= P(X \lt 9) \\[3pt] &= P(X \in \{ 0,1,\ldots,8 \}) \\[3pt] &= P(X \in \{ 0,1,2,3,4 \}) + P(X \in \{ 5,6,7,8 \}) \\[3pt] &= P(X \leq 4) + P(5 \leq X \lt 9) \\[3pt] &= F(4) + P(5 \leq X \lt 9). \end{align*}

Therefore,

\begin{align*} P(5 \leq X \lt 9) &= F(8) - F(4) \\[3pt] &= 0.9962 - 0.8153\\[3pt] &= 0.1809. \end{align*}

question.text:
Using the cumulative distribution function table of the Poisson random variable $X \sim \textrm{Po}(2.7)$ given below, compute $P(X \gt 7).$

$ \quad x \quad $ $2$ $3$ $4$ $5$ $6$ $7$ $8$
$ P(X\leq x) $ $\,0.4936\,$ $\,0.7141\,$ $\,0.8629\,$ $\,0.9433\,$ $\,0.9794\,$ $\,0.9934\,$ $\,0.9981\,$
question.explanation:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

\[ F(x) = P(X \leq x). \]

To solve the given problem, we can use the rule

\[ P(X > a) = 1 - P(X\leq a) = 1-F(a). \]

Therefore,

\begin{align*} P(X > 7) &= 1 - P(X\leq 7)\\[5pt] &= 1 - F(7)\\[5pt] &= 1 - 0.9934\\[3pt] &= 0.0066. \end{align*}
